timingMethod: Seven alternating trials of eight calls per workload. Previous handler code replay and actual current handler share current refresh/backend code and the same owned window. No older executable or IDM timing comparison; no timing pass threshold.
timingInterpretation: Protected-capture medians improve strongly in this run: filtered 146.84 to 4.82 ms, unfiltered 135.29 to 2.70 ms. Filename medians are slightly higher: filtered 1.41 to 1.52 ms and unfiltered 1.92 to 2.01 ms, with overlapping trial ranges. Treat the small-case performance effect as unresolved; do not claim every workload is faster.

cachePolicy.eviction: Least recently used; marking cohort membership alone does not promote entries
cachePolicy.accounting: Counts JSON values, object key strings and string payloads. This is a retained snapshot budget, not whole-process RSS, allocator capacity or source-job memory.
cachePolicy.oversized: Compute the matching result without retaining the snapshot

semantics: Bind cache identity to the saved normalized query independently of visible filtering. Mark current category/queue candidates without rematching when filtering is hidden, then evict unseen entries. Compare live source fields under the manager lock before reuse; copy and match misses outside it. Cache verified negative results too. Expected-query checks prevent reuse/publication under a different query.
coverage: Query clearing and stale-query publication refusal
Filtered and unfiltered capture/filename selection and wrapping
Hidden-query changes and changed protected sources
Stale positive to negative and restored positive
Category eviction and recomputation on returning to All Downloads

recovery.disk: C: filled during App.obj output. Final production and test targets written to shared D: build root with current core/library objects reused from C:; no media tools copied.
recovery.cleanup: Five exact old generated object paths removed. Immediate reported C: free space did not increase; selected logical sizes are not claimed as physical reclamation. See generated-test-object-cleanup-7.52.json.
recovery.allocation: Initial cache fixture aborted with bad allocation after 29 checks under low commit headroom. Unused earlier large fixture copies were released before independent cases; the full final fixture passes 46 checks with observed peak private memory approximately 31.4 MiB. This is test-process observation, not application memory acceptance.
recovery.host: A PowerShell launch failed with paging-file error 0x800705AF before executing the command. Used cmd/Python and direct pinned compiler flags from native/build.ps1 for the window fixture to avoid retaining the PowerShell host. No unrelated user processes stopped or system settings changed.

componentBuild.method: Direct pinned compiler invocation matching native/build.ps1; avoid a persistent PowerShell host during low system commit

productionArtifactSelection.method: Select only the five production names in the build receipt; this shared development output also contains fixture executables and is not a release package.

visualScope: Fresh owned Find render reused only when byte-identical to the previously inspected image; otherwise requires inspection. No new installed or IDM visual acceptance claim.
